en: Today in History
zh: 今天的歷史
ja: 今日は歴史の日です
local: Today in History
ja_pron: Kyou wa rekishi no hi desu
native: Today in History

en: August 12, IBM introduced the Personal Computer and accelerated the PC Revolution.
zh: 8月12日，IBM推出了個人電腦並加速了個人電腦革命。
ja: 8月12日、IBMはパーソナルコンピュータを発表し、PC革命を加速させました。
local: August 12, IBM introduced the Personal Computer and accelerated the PC Revolution.
ja_pron: Hachigatsu jūnichi, IBM wa pāsonaru konpyūta o happyō shi, PC kakumei o kasoku saremashita.
native: August 12, IBM introduced the Personal Computer and accelerated the PC Revolution.

en: On August 12, 1981, IBM officially introduced the IBM Personal Computer, known as the Model 5150.
zh: 1981年8月12日，IBM正式推出了被稱為Model 5150的IBM個人電腦。
ja: 1981年8月12日、IBMはModel 5150として知られるIBMパーソナルコンピュータを正式に発表しました。
local: On August 12, 1981, IBM officially introduced the IBM Personal Computer, known as the Model 5150.
ja_pron: Sen kyūhyaku hachijū ichi nen hachigatsu jūnichi, IBM wa Model 5150 to shira reru IBM pāsonaru konpyūta o seishiki ni happyō shimashita.
native: On August 12, 1981, IBM officially introduced the IBM Personal Computer, known as the Model 5150.

en: Personal computers already existed before IBM entered the market, Apple, Commodore, Tandy, Joe Radio Shack, and other companies had already produced machines for consumers and hobbyists.
zh: 在IBM進入市場之前，個人電腦已經存在，蘋果、康懋達、坦迪、Joe Radio Shack和其他公司已經為消費者和愛好者生產了機器。
ja: IBMが市場に参入する前から、パーソナルコンピュータは存在しており、Apple、Commodore、Tandy、Joe Radio Shackなどの企業が消費者や趣味のための機械を製造していました。
local: Personal computers already existed before IBM entered the market, Apple, Commodore, Tandy, Joe Radio Shack, and other companies had already produced machines for consumers and hobbyists.
ja_pron: IBM ga shijō ni sannyū suru mae kara, pāsonaru konpyūta wa sonzai shite ori, Apple, Commodore, Tandy, Joe Radio Shack nado no kigyō ga shōhisha ya shumi no tame no kikai o seizō shite imashita.
native: Personal computers already existed before IBM entered the market, Apple, Commodore, Tandy, Joe Radio Shack, and other companies had already produced machines for consumers and hobbyists.

en: IBM's importance was different. One of the world's most powerful and respected computer companies was entering the personal computer market and giving the technology enormous.
zh: IBM的重要性不同。世界上最強大且受尊敬的電腦公司之一進入了個人電腦市場，並賦予這項技術巨大的影響力。
ja: IBMの重要性は異なりました。世界で最も強力で尊敬されるコンピュータ企業の一つがパーソナルコンピュータ市場に参入し、その技術に大きな影響を与えました。
local: IBM's importance was different. One of the world's most powerful and respected computer companies was entering the personal computer market and giving the technology enormous.
ja_pron: IBM no jūyōsei wa kotonarimashita. Sekai de mottomo kyōryoku de sonkei sareru konpyūta kigyō no hitotsu ga pāsonaru konpyūta shijō ni sannyū shi, sono gijutsu ni ōkina eikyō o ataemashita.
native: IBM's importance was different. One of the world's most powerful and respected computer companies was entering the personal computer market and giving the technology enormous.

en: Credibility.
zh: 可信度。
ja: 信頼性です。
local: Credibility.
ja_pron: Shinraisei desu.
native: Credibility.

en: The IBM PC was built around an Intel 8088, processor running at 477 Mhz.
zh: IBM PC是以Intel 8088處理器為核心，運行頻率為4.77 MHz。
ja: IBM PCはIntel 8088プロセッサを中心に構築され、動作周波数は4.77MHzでした。
local: The IBM PC was built around an Intel 8088, processor running at 477 Mhz.
ja_pron: IBM PC wa Intel 8088 purosessa o chūshin ni kōchiku sare, dōsa shūhasū wa 4.77 MHz deshita.
native: The IBM PC was built around an Intel 8088, processor running at 477 Mhz.

en: Its basic configuration contained only 16 kilobytes of memory, and the original system did not even include a disk drive.
zh: 其基本配置僅包含16KB記憶體，且原始系統甚至不包含磁碟機。
ja: 基本構成はわずか16キロバイトのメモリを搭載し、元のシステムにはディスクドライブさえ含まれていませんでした。
local: Its basic configuration contained only 16 kilobytes of memory, and the original system did not even include a disk drive.
ja_pron: Kihon kōsei wa wazuka 16 kirobaito no memori o tōsai shi, moto no shisutemu ni wa disuku doraibu sae fukumarete imasen deshita.
native: Its basic configuration contained only 16 kilobytes of memory, and the original system did not even include a disk drive.

en: IBM's introductory price was $1 for $965 while adding a display, diskette drives, and a printer could add thousands of dollars to the cost.
zh: IBM的起始價格為965美元，若加上顯示器、磁碟機和印表機，成本可增加數千美元。
ja: IBMの導入価格は965ドルでしたが、ディスプレイ、ディスケットドライブ、プリンターを追加すると数千ドルの費用がかかりました。
local: IBM's introductory price was $1 for $965 while adding a display, diskette drives, and a printer could add thousands of dollars to the cost.
ja_pron: IBM no dōnyū kakaku wa 965 doru deshita ga, disupurei, disuketto doraibu, purintā o tsuika suru to sūsen doru no hiyō ga kakarimashita.
native: IBM's introductory price was $1 for $965 while adding a display, diskette drives, and a printer could add thousands of dollars to the cost.

en: By modern standards, the machine was extremely limited, but in 1981, it represented an important new direction for business computing.
zh: 以現代標準來看，這台機器非常有限，但在1981年，它代表了商業計算的一個重要新方向。
ja: 現代の基準ではこの機械は非常に制限されていましたが、1981年にはビジネスコンピューティングの重要な新しい方向性を示していました。
local: By modern standards, the machine was extremely limited, but in 1981, it represented an important new direction for business computing.
ja_pron: Gendai no kijun de wa kono kikai wa hijō ni seigen sarete imashita ga, 1981-nen ni wa bijinesu konpyūtingu no jūyō na atarashii hōkōsei o shimeshite imashita.
native: By modern standards, the machine was extremely limited, but in 1981, it represented an important new direction for business computing.

en: One of IBM's most important decisions was to build the PC using an open architecture.
zh: IBM最重要的決定之一是使用開放架構來打造PC。
ja: IBMの最も重要な決定の一つは、オープンアーキテクチャを使ってPCを構築することでした。
local: One of IBM's most important decisions was to build the PC using an open architecture.
ja_pron: IBM no mottomo jūyō na kettei no hitotsu wa, ōpun ākitekucha o tsukatte PC o kōchiku suru koto deshita.
native: One of IBM's most important decisions was to build the PC using an open architecture.

en: Unlike many of IBM's earlier computer systems, the company relied heavily on commercially available components rather than designing every part itself.
zh: 與IBM早期許多電腦系統不同，公司大量依賴市售零件，而非自行設計每個部分。
ja: IBMの以前の多くのコンピュータシステムとは異なり、同社はすべての部品を設計するのではなく、市販の部品に大きく依存しました。
local: Unlike many of IBM's earlier computer systems, the company relied heavily on commercially available components rather than designing every part itself.
ja_pron: IBM no izen no ōku no konpyūta shisutemu to wa kotonari, dōsha wa subete no buhin o sekkei suru no de wa naku, shihan no buhin ni ōkiku izon shimashita.
native: Unlike many of IBM's earlier computer systems, the company relied heavily on commercially available components rather than designing every part itself.

en: The processor came from Intel, while the operating system was supplied through Microsoft's relationship with IBM.
zh: 處理器來自Intel，而作業系統則是透過微軟與IBM的合作提供。
ja: プロセッサはIntel製で、オペレーティングシステムはMicrosoftとIBMの関係を通じて提供されました。
local: The processor came from Intel, while the operating system was supplied through Microsoft's relationship with IBM.
ja_pron: Purosessa wa Intel-sei de, operētingu shisutemu wa Microsoft to IBM no kankei o tsūjite teikyō saremashita.
native: The processor came from Intel, while the operating system was supplied through Microsoft's relationship with IBM.

en: The system was released with PC DoS, while Microsoft also licensed the operating system as MMS DOS to other manufacturers.
zh: 系統搭載PC DOS發行，微軟也將作業系統授權為MMS DOS給其他製造商。
ja: システムはPC DOSと共にリリースされ、Microsoftは他のメーカーにもMMS DOSとしてオペレーティングシステムのライセンスを供与しました。
local: The system was released with PC DoS, while Microsoft also licensed the operating system as MMS DOS to other manufacturers.
ja_pron: Shisutemu wa PC DOS to tomo ni rirīsu sare, Microsoft wa hoka no mēkā ni mo MMS DOS to shite operētingu shisutemu no raisensu o kyōyo shimashita.
native: The system was released with PC DoS, while Microsoft also licensed the operating system as MMS DOS to other manufacturers.

en: The decision to use an open architecture had enormous consequences. IBM published technical information that allowed other companies to create compatible hardware and software.
zh: 使用開放架構的決定帶來巨大影響。IBM公開了技術資訊，使其他公司能夠製造相容的硬體和軟體。
ja: オープンアーキテクチャを採用した決定は大きな影響をもたらしました。IBMは技術情報を公開し、他の企業が互換性のあるハードウェアやソフトウェアを作成できるようにしました。
local: The decision to use an open architecture had enormous consequences. IBM published technical information that allowed other companies to create compatible hardware and software.
ja_pron: Ōpun ākitekucha o saiyō shita kettei wa ōkina eikyō o motarashimashita. IBM wa gijutsu jōhō o kōkai shi, hoka no kigyō ga gokansei no aru hādowea ya sofutowea o sakusei dekiru yō ni shimashita.
native: The decision to use an open architecture had enormous consequences. IBM published technical information that allowed other companies to create compatible hardware and software.

en: Soon, an ecosystem developed around the IBM PC.
zh: 很快，圍繞IBM PC形成了一個生態系統。
ja: やがて、IBM PCを中心としたエコシステムが発展しました。
local: Soon, an ecosystem developed around the IBM PC.
ja_pron: Yagate, IBM PC o chūshin to shita ekoshisutemu ga hatten shimashita.
native: Soon, an ecosystem developed around the IBM PC.

en: Companies produced memory expansions, peripheral devices, software, and eventually entire compatible computers.
zh: 公司生產記憶體擴充、周邊設備、軟體，最終甚至整套相容電腦。
ja: 企業はメモリ拡張、周辺機器、ソフトウェアを製造し、最終的には完全に互換性のあるコンピュータ全体を作り出しました。
local: Companies produced memory expansions, peripheral devices, software, and eventually entire compatible computers.
ja_pron: Kigyō wa memori kakuchō, shūhen kiki, sofutowea o seizō shi, saishūteki ni wa kanzen ni gokansei no aru konpyūta zentai o tsukuridashimashita.
native: Companies produced memory expansions, peripheral devices, software, and eventually entire compatible computers.

en: This created one of the great ironies of IBM's PC history.
zh: 這造就了IBM個人電腦歷史上的一大諷刺。
ja: これはIBMのPCの歴史における大きな皮肉の一つを生み出しました。
local: This created one of the great ironies of IBM's PC history.
ja_pron: Kore wa IBM no PC no rekishi ni okeru ōkina hiniku no hitotsu o umidashimashita.
native: This created one of the great ironies of IBM's PC history.

en: IBM helped establish the architecture as an industry standard, but the same openness allowed competitors to build compatible systems.
zh: IBM協助將此架構建立為產業標準，但同樣的開放性也讓競爭者能建造相容系統。
ja: IBMはこのアーキテクチャを業界標準として確立するのを助けましたが、同じ開放性が競合他社に互換システムを構築させました。
local: IBM helped establish the architecture as an industry standard, but the same openness allowed competitors to build compatible systems.
ja_pron: IBM wa kono ākitekucha o gyōkai hyōjun to shite kakuritsu suru no o tasukemashita ga, onaji kaihō-sei ga kyōgō tasha ni gokansei shisutemu o kōchiku sasemashita.
native: IBM helped establish the architecture as an industry standard, but the same openness allowed competitors to build compatible systems.

en: In 1983, Compaq introduced an IBM compatible computer, and the clone market began to grow.
zh: 1983年，Compaq推出了IBM相容電腦，克隆市場開始成長。
ja: 1983年、CompaqはIBM互換のコンピュータを発売し、クローン市場が成長し始めました。
local: In 1983, Compaq introduced an IBM compatible computer, and the clone market began to grow.
ja_pron: 1983-nen, Compaq wa IBM gokansei no konpyūta o hatsubai shi, kurōn shijō ga seichō shi hajimemashita.
native: In 1983, Compaq introduced an IBM compatible computer, and the clone market began to grow.

en: Over time, IBM's own share of the PC market declined, even though its architecture remained enormously influential.
zh: 隨著時間推移，IBM在個人電腦市場的份額下降，儘管其架構仍具有巨大影響力。
ja: 時間が経つにつれて、IBM自身のPC市場でのシェアは減少しましたが、そのアーキテクチャは非常に影響力を持ち続けました。
local: Over time, IBM's own share of the PC market declined, even though its architecture remained enormously influential.
ja_pron: Jikan ga tatsu ni tsurete, IBM jishin no PC shijō de no shea wa genshō shimashita ga, sono ākitekucha wa hijō ni eikyōryoku o mochitsuzukemashita.
native: Over time, IBM's own share of the PC market declined, even though its architecture remained enormously influential.

en: The IBM PC's biggest impact was probably in the workplace.
zh: IBM PC最大的影響可能是在職場上。
ja: IBM PCの最大の影響はおそらく職場にありました。
local: The IBM PC's biggest impact was probably in the workplace.
ja_pron: IBM PC no saidai no eikyō wa osoraku shokuba ni arimashita.
native: The IBM PC's biggest impact was probably in the workplace.

en: Before the personal computer became common, computing was often associated with large, centralized machines, operated by specialists.
zh: 在個人電腦普及之前，計算通常與大型集中式機器相關，由專家操作。
ja: パーソナルコンピュータが一般的になる前は、コンピューティングはしばしば大規模で集中管理された機械と結びついており、専門家が操作していました。
local: Before the personal computer became common, computing was often associated with large, centralized machines, operated by specialists.
ja_pron: Pāsonaru konpyūta ga ippanteki ni naru mae wa, konpyūtingu wa shibashiba daikibo de shūchū kanri sareta kikai to musubitsuite ori, senmonka ga sōsa shite imashita.
native: Before the personal computer became common, computing was often associated with large, centralized machines, operated by specialists.

en: The PC brought computing directly onto the office desk.
zh: 個人電腦將計算直接帶到辦公桌上。
ja: PCはコンピューティングを直接オフィスの机に持ち込みました。
local: The PC brought computing directly onto the office desk.
ja_pron: PC wa konpyūtingu o chokusetsu ofisu no tsukue ni mochikomi mashita.
native: The PC brought computing directly onto the office desk.

en: Workers could use computers for word processing, spreadsheets, databases, accounting, communication, and many other tasks.
zh: 員工可以使用電腦進行文字處理、試算表、資料庫、會計、通訊及許多其他工作。
ja: 労働者はコンピュータを使ってワードプロセッシング、スプレッドシート、データベース、会計、コミュニケーションなど多くの作業を行うことができました。
local: Workers could use computers for word processing, spreadsheets, databases, accounting, communication, and many other tasks.
ja_pron: Rōdōsha wa konpyūta o tsukatte wādo purosesshingu, supureddoshīto, dētābēsu, kaikei, komyunikēshon nado ōku no sagyō o okonau koto ga dekimashita.
native: Workers could use computers for word processing, spreadsheets, databases, accounting, communication, and many other tasks.

en: The personal computer became a practical business tool, rather than simply an expensive technical curiosity.
zh: 個人電腦成為實用的商業工具，而不僅僅是昂貴的技術新奇物。
ja: パーソナルコンピュータは単なる高価な技術的好奇心ではなく、実用的なビジネスツールとなりました。
local: The personal computer became a practical business tool, rather than simply an expensive technical curiosity.
ja_pron: Pāsonaru konpyūta wa tannaru kōka na gijutsuteki kōkishin de wa naku, jitsuyō-teki na bijinesu tsūru to narimashita.
native: The personal computer became a practical business tool, rather than simply an expensive technical curiosity.

en: The software ecosystem was equally important.
zh: 軟體生態系統同樣重要。
ja: ソフトウェアのエコシステムも同様に重要でした。
local: The software ecosystem was equally important.
ja_pron: Sofutowea no ekoshisutemu mo dōyō ni jūyō deshita.
native: The software ecosystem was equally important.

en: IBM's PC helped introduce MS-DOS to a huge new user base and contributed to the development of a large, software industry.
zh: IBM的PC幫助將MS-DOS介紹給龐大的新用戶群，並促進了大型軟體產業的發展。
ja: IBMのPCはMS-DOSを大規模な新しいユーザーベースに紹介し、大きなソフトウェア産業の発展に貢献しました。
local: IBM's PC helped introduce MS-DOS to a huge new user base and contributed to the development of a large, software industry.
ja_pron: IBM no PC wa MS-DOS o daikibo na atarashii yūzā bēsu ni shōkai shi, ōkina sofutowea sangyō no hatten ni kōken shimashita.
native: IBM's PC helped introduce MS-DOS to a huge new user base and contributed to the development of a large, software industry.

en: Within a year of the launch, more than 750 software packages were available for the IBM PC.
zh: 發表一年內，已有超過750個軟體套件可用於IBM PC。
ja: 発売から1年以内に、IBM PC向けに750以上のソフトウェアパッケージが利用可能になりました。
local: Within a year of the launch, more than 750 software packages were available for the IBM PC.
ja_pron: Hatsubai kara ichi-nen inai ni, IBM PC muke ni 750 ijō no sofutowea pakkēji ga riyō kanō ni narimashita.
native: Within a year of the launch, more than 750 software packages were available for the IBM PC.

en: This demonstrates an important principle of technology history.
zh: 這顯示了科技歷史上一個重要的原則。
ja: これは技術史における重要な原則を示しています。
local: This demonstrates an important principle of technology history.
ja_pron: Kore wa gijutsu-shi ni okeru jūyō na gensoku o shimeshite imasu.
native: This demonstrates an important principle of technology history.

en: Hardware, alone, rarely creates a technological revolution.
zh: 單靠硬體，很少能創造科技革命。
ja: ハードウェアだけで技術革命を起こすことはめったにありません。
local: Hardware, alone, rarely creates a technological revolution.
ja_pron: Hādowea dake de gijutsu kakumei o okosu koto wa mettani arimasen.
native: Hardware, alone, rarely creates a technological revolution.

en: A successful platform needs software developers, applications, accessories, users, and businesses willing to invest in it.
zh: 一個成功的平台需要軟體開發者、應用程式、配件、使用者和願意投資的企業。
ja: 成功したプラットフォームには、ソフトウェア開発者、アプリケーション、アクセサリー、ユーザー、そして投資をいとわない企業が必要です。
local: A successful platform needs software developers, applications, accessories, users, and businesses willing to invest in it.
ja_pron: Seikō shita purattofōmu ni wa, sofutowea kaihatsu-sha, apurikēshon, akusesarī, yūzā, soshite tōshi o itowanai kigyō ga hitsuyō desu.
native: A successful platform needs software developers, applications, accessories, users, and businesses willing to invest in it.

en: The IBM PC created exactly this kind of ecosystem.
zh: IBM PC正是創造了這樣的生態系統。
ja: IBM PCはまさにこのようなエコシステムを作り出しました。
local: The IBM PC created exactly this kind of ecosystem.
ja_pron: IBM PC wa masani kono yō na ekoshisutemu o tsukuridashimashita.
native: The IBM PC created exactly this kind of ecosystem.

en: IBM's strong reputation also helped change the perception of personal computers.
zh: IBM強大的聲譽也幫助改變了人們對個人電腦的看法。
ja: IBMの強力な評判は、パーソナルコンピュータに対する認識を変えるのにも役立ちました。
local: IBM's strong reputation also helped change the perception of personal computers.
ja_pron: IBM no kyōryoku na hyōban wa, pāsonaru konpyūta ni taisuru ninshiki o kaeru no ni mo yakudachimashita.
native: IBM's strong reputation also helped change the perception of personal computers.

en: The company had been associated with large business computers, so its entry into the PC market reassured many businesses that personal computers were serious tools.
zh: 該公司一直與大型商業電腦相關，因此其進入PC市場讓許多企業相信個人電腦是嚴肅的工具。
ja: 同社は大型ビジネスコンピュータと関連していたため、PC市場への参入は多くの企業にパーソナルコンピュータが真剣なツールであると安心させました。
local: The company had been associated with large business computers, so its entry into the PC market reassured many businesses that personal computers were serious tools.
ja_pron: Dōsha wa ōgata bijinesu konpyūta to kanren shite ita tame, PC shijō e no sannyū wa ōku no kigyō ni pāsonaru konpyūta ga shinken na tsūru de aru to anshin sasemashita.
native: The company had been associated with large business computers, so its entry into the PC market reassured many businesses that personal computers were serious tools.

en: The computer history museum describes the IBM PC as helping change the perception of the personal computer from something resembling a hobbyist's machine into a legitimate business tool.
zh: 電腦歷史博物館描述IBM PC幫助將個人電腦的觀念從類似愛好者的機器轉變為合法的商業工具。
ja: コンピュータ歴史博物館は、IBM PCがパーソナルコンピュータの認識を趣味人の機械のようなものから正当なビジネスツールへと変えるのを助けたと説明しています。
local: The computer history museum describes the IBM PC as helping change the perception of the personal computer from something resembling a hobbyist's machine into a legitimate business tool.
ja_pron: Konpyūta rekishi hakubutsukan wa, IBM PC ga pāsonaru konpyūta no ninshiki o shumi hito no kikai no yō na mono kara seitō na bijinesu tsūru e to kaeru no o tasuketa to setsumei shite imasu.
native: The computer history museum describes the IBM PC as helping change the perception of the personal computer from something resembling a hobbyist's machine into a legitimate business tool.

en: The impact continued far beyond IBM itself.
zh: 這種影響遠遠超過了IBM本身。
ja: その影響はIBM自体をはるかに超えて続きました。
local: The impact continued far beyond IBM itself.
ja_pron: Sono eikyō wa IBM jitai o haruka ni koete tsuzukimashita.
native: The impact continued far beyond IBM itself.

en: The PC architecture became a foundation for an enormous computer industry.
zh: PC架構成為龐大電腦產業的基礎。
ja: PCのアーキテクチャは巨大なコンピュータ産業の基盤となりました。
local: The PC architecture became a foundation for an enormous computer industry.
ja_pron: PC no ākitekucha wa kyodai na konpyūta sangyō no kiban to narimashita.
native: The PC architecture became a foundation for an enormous computer industry.

en: Microsoft grew alongside the PC ecosystem, eventually developing windows into the dominant desktop operating environment.
zh: 微軟隨著PC生態系統成長，最終將Windows發展成主導的桌面作業環境。
ja: MicrosoftはPCのエコシステムと共に成長し、最終的にWindowsを支配的なデスクトップオペレーティング環境に発展させました。
local: Microsoft grew alongside the PC ecosystem, eventually developing windows into the dominant desktop operating environment.
ja_pron: Microsoft wa PC no ekoshisutemu to tomo ni seichō shi, saishūteki ni Windows o shihaiteki na desukutoppu operētingu kankyō ni hatten sasemashita.
native: Microsoft grew alongside the PC ecosystem, eventually developing windows into the dominant desktop operating environment.

en: Hardware manufacturers built compatible computers, while software companies created increasingly sophisticated applications.
zh: 硬體製造商打造相容電腦，軟體公司則創造越來越複雜的應用程式。
ja: ハードウェアメーカーは互換性のあるコンピュータを製造し、ソフトウェア会社はますます洗練されたアプリケーションを作成しました。
local: Hardware manufacturers built compatible computers, while software companies created increasingly sophisticated applications.
ja_pron: Hādowea mēkā wa gokansei no aru konpyūta o seizō shi, sofutowea gaisha wa masumasu senren sareta apurikēshon o sakusei shimashita.
native: Hardware manufacturers built compatible computers, while software companies created increasingly sophisticated applications.

en: By the late 20th century, personal computers were becoming common in offices, schools, and homes.
zh: 到了20世紀末，個人電腦在辦公室、學校和家庭中變得普遍。
ja: 20世紀後半には、パーソナルコンピュータはオフィス、学校、家庭で一般的になっていました。
local: By the late 20th century, personal computers were becoming common in offices, schools, and homes.
ja_pron: 20 seiki kōhan ni wa, pāsonaru konpyūta wa ofisu, gakkō, katei de ippanteki ni natte imashita.
native: By the late 20th century, personal computers were becoming common in offices, schools, and homes.

en: People were using them to write documents, calculate budgets, create graphics, play games, learn programming, communicate, and eventually access the internet.
zh: 人們使用它們來撰寫文件、計算預算、製作圖形、玩遊戲、學習程式設計、溝通，最終還能上網。
ja: 人々は文書作成、予算計算、グラフィック作成、ゲームプレイ、プログラミング学習、コミュニケーション、そして最終的にはインターネットへのアクセスに使用していました。
local: People were using them to write documents, calculate budgets, create graphics, play games, learn programming, communicate, and eventually access the internet.
ja_pron: Hitobito wa bunsho sakusei, yosan keisan, gurafikku sakusei, gēmu purei, puroguramingu gakushū, komyunikēshon, soshite saishūteki ni wa intānetto e no akusesu ni shiyō shite imashita.
native: People were using them to write documents, calculate budgets, create graphics, play games, learn programming, communicate, and eventually access the internet.

en: The transformation from the original IBM 5150 to today's computers is extraordinary.
zh: 從原始的IBM 5150到今天的電腦，變化非凡。
ja: 元のIBM 5150から今日のコンピュータへの変化は驚異的です。
local: The transformation from the original IBM 5150 to today's computers is extraordinary.
ja_pron: Moto no IBM 5150 kara kyō no konpyūta e no henka wa kyōiteki desu.
native: The transformation from the original IBM 5150 to today's computers is extraordinary.

en: The first IBM PC had only 16 co-abed of memory, and a processor running at 4.77 mAhlints.
zh: 第一台IBM PC只有16KB記憶體，處理器運行速度為4.77 MHz。
ja: 最初のIBM PCはわずか16キロバイトのメモリと4.77MHzで動作するプロセッサを搭載していました。
local: The first IBM PC had only 16 co-abed of memory, and a processor running at 4.77 mAhlints.
ja_pron: Saisho no IBM PC wa wazuka 16 kirobaito no memori to 4.77 MHz de dōsa suru purosessa o tōsai shite imashita.
native: The first IBM PC had only 16 co-abed of memory, and a processor running at 4.77 mAhlints.

en: Modern computers are millions of times more capable in many respects, and can process high-resolution video, large databases, advanced graphics, and artificial intelligence workloads.
zh: 現代電腦在許多方面的能力是數百萬倍，能處理高解析度影片、大型資料庫、先進圖形和人工智慧工作負載。
ja: 現代のコンピュータは多くの面で何百万倍も高性能で、高解像度のビデオ、大規模なデータベース、高度なグラフィックス、人工知能のワークロードを処理できます。
local: Modern computers are millions of times more capable in many respects, and can process high-resolution video, large databases, advanced graphics, and artificial intelligence workloads.
ja_pron: Gendai no konpyūta wa ōku no men de nanbyakuman-bai mo kōseinō de, kōkaizōdo no bideo, daikibo na dētābēsu, kōdo na gurafikkusu, jinkō chinō no wākurōdo o shori dekimasu.
native: Modern computers are millions of times more capable in many respects, and can process high-resolution video, large databases, advanced graphics, and artificial intelligence workloads.

en: Yet the basic idea remains recognizable, a computer placed directly in the hands of an individual user.
zh: 然而基本概念仍然可辨識，即將電腦直接放在個別使用者手中。
ja: しかし基本的な考え方は認識可能なままで、コンピュータが個々のユーザーの手に直接置かれています。
local: Yet the basic idea remains recognizable, a computer placed directly in the hands of an individual user.
ja_pron: Shikashi kihonteki na kangaekata wa ninshiki kanō na mama de, konpyūta ga koko no yūzā no te ni chokusetsu okarete imasu.
native: Yet the basic idea remains recognizable, a computer placed directly in the hands of an individual user.

en: The history of August 12, 1981, is therefore not simply the story of IBM releasing another computer.
zh: 因此，1981年8月12日的歷史不僅僅是IBM發布另一台電腦的故事。
ja: したがって、1981年8月12日の歴史は単にIBMが別のコンピュータを発売した話ではありません。
local: The history of August 12, 1981, is therefore not simply the story of IBM releasing another computer.
ja_pron: Shitagatte, 1981-nen 8-gatsu 12-nichi no rekishi wa tan ni IBM ga betsu no konpyūta o hatsubai shita hanashi de wa arimasen.
native: The history of August 12, 1981, is therefore not simply the story of IBM releasing another computer.

en: It represents a major step in the movement of computing from specialized institutions into everyday life.
zh: 它代表了計算從專門機構進入日常生活的重要一步。
ja: これはコンピューティングが専門機関から日常生活へ移行する大きな一歩を示しています。
local: It represents a major step in the movement of computing from specialized institutions into everyday life.
ja_pron: Kore wa konpyūtingu ga senmon kikan kara nichijō seikatsu e ikō suru ōkina ippo o shimeshite imasu.
native: It represents a major step in the movement of computing from specialized institutions into everyday life.

en: The IBM PC was not the first personal computer, but IBM helped make the personal computer a mainstream business platform.
zh: IBM PC不是第一台個人電腦，但IBM幫助使個人電腦成為主流商業平台。
ja: IBM PCは最初のパーソナルコンピュータではありませんでしたが、IBMはパーソナルコンピュータを主流のビジネスプラットフォームにするのを助けました。
local: The IBM PC was not the first personal computer, but IBM helped make the personal computer a mainstream business platform.
ja_pron: IBM PC wa saisho no pāsonaru konpyūta de wa arimasen deshita ga, IBM wa pāsonaru konpyūta o shuryū no bijinesu purattofōmu ni suru no o tasukemashita.
native: The IBM PC was not the first personal computer, but IBM helped make the personal computer a mainstream business platform.

en: Its open architecture encouraged a huge ecosystem of hardware and software, while its brand gave the emerging PC industry a level of legitimacy that helped accelerate adoption.
zh: 其開放架構促進了龐大的硬體和軟體生態系統，其品牌則為新興的PC產業帶來了合法性，促進了採用速度。
ja: そのオープンアーキテクチャは巨大なハードウェアとソフトウェアのエコシステムを促進し、そのブランドは新興のPC業界に正当性をもたらし、採用の加速を助けました。
local: Its open architecture encouraged a huge ecosystem of hardware and software, while its brand gave the emerging PC industry a level of legitimacy that helped accelerate adoption.
ja_pron: Sono ōpun ākitekucha wa kyodai na hādowea to sofutowea no ekoshisutemu o sokushin shi, sono burando wa shinkō no PC gyōkai ni seitōsei o motarashi, saiyō no kasoku o tasukemashita.
native: Its open architecture encouraged a huge ecosystem of hardware and software, while its brand gave the emerging PC industry a level of legitimacy that helped accelerate adoption.

en: From a machine with 16 kilobytes of memory to the powerful computers used today, the personal computer has transformed work, education, entertainment, communication, and creativity.
zh: 從擁有16KB記憶體的機器到今天強大的電腦，個人電腦改變了工作、教育、娛樂、通訊和創造力。
ja: 16キロバイトのメモリを持つ機械から今日使われている強力なコンピュータまで、パーソナルコンピュータは仕事、教育、娯楽、コミュニケーション、創造性を変革しました。
local: From a machine with 16 kilobytes of memory to the powerful computers used today, the personal computer has transformed work, education, entertainment, communication, and creativity.
ja_pron: 16 kirobaito no memori o motsu kikai kara kyō tsukawarete iru kyōryoku na konpyūta made, pāsonaru konpyūta wa shigoto, kyōiku, goraku, komyunikēshon, sōzōsei o henkaku shimashita.
native: From a machine with 16 kilobytes of memory to the powerful computers used today, the personal computer has transformed work, education, entertainment, communication, and creativity.

en: And one of the important dates in that transformation is August 12, 1981.
zh: 而這場變革中重要的日期之一是1981年8月12日。
ja: そして、その変革の重要な日付の一つが1981年8月12日です。
local: And one of the important dates in that transformation is August 12, 1981.
ja_pron: Soshite, sono henkaku no jūyō na hizuke no hitotsu ga 1981-nen 8-gatsu 12-nichi desu.
native: And one of the important dates in that transformation is August 12, 1981.
